desc: Establish that only reversal parity matters, yielding two orientation states per vertex.
Derive movement transitions: original outgoing edges in parity 0, original incoming edges in parity 1, and cost-`X` parity switches.
Implement and verify the complete implicit two-layer Dijkstra solution with 64-bit-safe distances and output the first finalized target state.
Confirm `O((N+M) log N)` time and `O(N+M)` memory.
